timeline.evidenceText: For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;

Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”

Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops, and like grain blasted before it has grown up.
Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is,

definitions.full: H3419. yaraq יָרָק noun [masculine] herbs (collective), herbage (green, greens) — absolute יָרָק Deut 11:10 2 t.; construct יְרַק Isa 37:27 = 2Kin 19:26 ; — גַּןיָֿרָק Deut 11:10 ; 1Kin 21:2 ; יָרָק אֲרֻחַת Prov 15:17 ; as substantive, דֶּשֶׁא יְרַק Isa 37:27 = 2Kin 19:26 green shoots of grass (|| שָׂדֶה עֵשֶׂב , etc.)
